newsitem.title: USA: Crestar Q3 loan loss provision rises.
newsitem.headline: Crestar Q3 loan loss provision rises.

text.p: Crestar Financial Corp said on Thursday that its provision for loan losses was $23.2 million for the quarter, up from $14.2 million in the same quarter last year and hurting core operating earnings.

Crestar said its core operating earnings were well below company expectations primarily due to uncertainty about consumer credit quality, which caused the company to take a cautious approach to loan growth in the quarter.
The company also said net charge-offs in the quarter rose to $24.4 million versus $16.9 million in 1995 third quarter.

But Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Richard Tilghman said Crestar expected fourth quarter earnings to rebound, due partly to the repricing of significant amounts of the copmany's credit card portfolio, and reduced expenses.
The company said average loans for the third quarter were $11.2 billion, down two percent from the second quarter.
